name: SDK-TS: iterExportReviews paginator
description: Add ProoflineClient.iterExportReviews to @proofline/sdk: an async generator over exportReviews pages that follows nextCursor safely, mirroring iterReviews. Never commit or push.

userStories.title: Implement iterExportReviews
userStories.description: As an analytics engineer, I want to iterate every export page without hand-writing cursor handling, so that a repeated cursor cannot loop forever. Add async *iterExportReviews(parameters, { maxPages }) to ProoflineClient in src/index.ts, right after exportReviews. Follow the Guardrails and the steps for this story in the source PRD (prd-iter-export-reviews.md).
acceptanceCriteria: iterExportReviews is a public method on ProoflineClient returning AsyncGenerator<ExportPage>
Follows nextCursor until null; only query.cursor changes between calls; starts from parameters.query.cursor when given
Repeated or already-seen cursor throws the protocol ProoflineError; exceeding maxPages (default 100) throws the pagination-limit ProoflineError
No generated file changed (git diff --stat shows only src/index.ts and optionally src/exports.ts)
`pnpm build` then `pnpm test` passes (all tests, offline)

userStories.title: Tests for iterExportReviews
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the paginator covered so regressions in cursor handling are caught. Add tests to tests/http.test.mjs next to the existing export tests. Follow the Guardrails and the steps for this story in the source PRD (prd-iter-export-reviews.md).
acceptanceCriteria: New tests cover: CSV multi-page, NDJSON multi-page, initial and opaque cursor passed back exactly, repeated cursor error, maxPages error, 403 on page 2 propagates without the token in the error text
notes records a mutation check (seen-cursor check removed -> a test fails -> restored)
`pnpm build` then `pnpm test` passes (all tests, offline)
